svg.title: Major third (M3): information sheet, phone layout
svg.desc: Major third, M3: C4 to E4, 4 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 4 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [4] lens: Modal family (rounded), ← Fundamental, Harmonic (Plogger), open/light.

g.text: 3 letter names counted inclusively (C to E)
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
The identity colour is a separate, artistic
Root C4 stays; upper note E4→E♭4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B same, C changes.
Root C4 stays; upper note E4→F4, one key
apart. Plogger: A changes, B same, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then
count 4 keys up, white and black, to E4. The
numbered arcs are those hops. Top left shows
the two notes one after another, top right
